name: AELDARI: WAVE SERPENT
description: Wave Serpents are the leading troop carriers in a craftworld's arsenal, bringing warriors to any part of the battlefield at immense speeds. The embarked soldiers are protected by a powerful energy field and receive covering fire from the vehicle's powerful array of heavy weapons. Falcon grav-tanks are sleek battle tanks of the Asuryani, mounting a diverse array of potent weapons that make them the bane of enemy war machines and foot troops alike.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds a Wave Serpent – a fast and well-protected transport vehicle for your Aeldari armies in Warhammer 40,000. It can alternatively build a Falcon, trading some transport capacity for turret-mounted heavy weapons.</br></br>The Wave Serpent is equipped with a turret-mounted twin shuriken cannon, and twin shuriken catapults mounted on the hull. The twin shuriken catapults can be replaced by a single shuriken cannon, while the twin shuriken cannon can be replaced with a twin missile launcher, bright lance, scatter laser, or star cannon, making your transport incredibly flexible. </br></br>The Falcon is equipped as standard with a turret-mounted scatter laser, and a hull-mounted twin shuriken catapult. The twin shuriken catapult can be replaced by a single shuriken cannon, while the scatter laser can be replaced with a missile launcher, bright lance, shuriken cannon, or star cannon, ensuring you always have the right weapon for your target.</br></br>This kit comprises 57 plastic components, 2x clear plastic components, 1x 60mm Flying Base, and 2x flying stems. This set also includes 1x Aeldari Transfer Sheet containing 378 waterslide transfers to customise your models. </br></br>This miniature is supplied unassembled and unpainted – we recommend Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
